_doc: The targets of the channel test of the server check (bench.channel; RESEARCH-node-score §2, tests 8 and 8b, §1.5). http: the download (GET) and the upload (POST) by the country of the node, in the order they are tried; «{bytes}» in a URL is the size of one request (at most max_req). iperf3: the public points of the Russian providers for test 8b (a node in Russia, by the button and with its own line of consent only, never by the schedule — SPEC NS-S5): tried one by one in this order until the first that answers; only the names are taken from bench.tlab.pw, never its code; abroad there is no 8b (the upload goes over HTTP). Checked 19.10 from a Mac: selectel 1GB/100MB 200, yandex ls-lR.gz 200 (38 MB), cloudflare __down 200 up to 99999999 bytes (100000000 — 403), __up 200 for 30 MB, ovh 1Gb.dat 200; the iperf3 points — not run (to the stand).
